customer: So I've been driving this compact sedan for a few years now and honestly it's just gotten too small for us, so I'm finally trading up to something bigger with you. Anyway, I was packing up the glovebox and it hit me that I have no idea what happens to my license plates when I hand the old car over. Do they just stay on it, or what? I'm in Virginia if that matters.
agent: Congrats on the upgrade! Per our article "What to do with your license plates," you'll want to remove your plates before you hand over your sedan and keep them. What you do with them after that is up to Virginia's motor vehicle agency, but you can usually transfer them to your next car.
